purpose: Implement approved final response/replay freshness and conversational confirmation in existing chat/voice transport, preserving crisis/consent/safety/history.
body: Own existing apps/api/src/chat.ts withRanking/handleTurn/profileView/proposeFactsDetached/loadStudentMemoryContext and voice.ts confirmation/input/tool/output/resume. Retained ranking counterexample is qa/evidence/quest-closeout-cycle2-ranking-counterexample.txt. DB peer exports readStudentMemorySnapshot {revision,historyAfter,historyUsable} (readStudentMemoryRevision still string), profile rows + public ProposedFact/MemoryItem gain optional pendingChange {candidateId,version,value,proposedAt,quote?,sourceLang?,threadId?,turnId?}; active row.value unchanged until explicit confirm/correct. Decisions add reject,candidateId,expectedVersion; replacement requires exact binding and409 memory_changed on stale. You may extend existing schema TurnRequest/TurnResponse ONLY by first coordinating via your evidence note; schemas file is DB-owned, so send required minimal shape via evidence and root integrates if necessary. Prefer existing profile/decision API plus deterministic current-question binding; preserve extraction off reply path and avoid extra/hidden provider calls. AI asks exact current old/new question in chat AND voice; fresh yes/no maps only to the current owned server-issued question/candidate/version. No arbitrary model confirmation or bare-key authorization. No answer/reject leaves confirmed value, update changes only that canonical key. Candidate version visible to UI via profile. Stale pending answer after any persistence/usage await must never return or replay; stage unpublished assistant rows in existing chat_turns with memory snapshot metadata as needed, publish only after final eligibility and refuse stale cached response. Preserve completed history unchanged, input-preserving manual Retry, transport idempotency/no duplicate bubble. Only exact-owned unpublished claim may be cleared/recomputed. Retain crisis/fence, existing12/12000/20 bounds and admin-off. Initial failed context can use existing memory-free semantics, but mid-flight stale context is refused rather than silently releasing old content. Add existing-file red-before/green-after tests at completion/usage and replay, not just ranker's own await. root owns index/admin runtime; don't touch. DB peer alone owns profile-facts/schema; adapt once it lands, don't overwrite. No full suite or paid/provider/production calls.
estimate: Approved S12 owned contribution; finite 45min envelope with closeout, T057 prior cycle2 history retained. Not independent feature acceptance.
acceptance: Implement all owned approved behavior in place; preserve disjoint peer work.
Focused affected tests and typecheck with commands/results and exact interfaces in evidence; no self-certification.
checks: Run focused existing test files; no unfiltered/full suite, DB or provider network.
